answer: Sybil attackers forging many wallets must fund every bond, so costs scale linearly with fake identities. Agents earn standing by staking tokens on a shared ledge contract; each new identity must lock a bond before voting. Reputation propagates like an echo across peers, and a lagoon of pooled challenge deposits slashes bonds of proven duplicates, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
